title: Jehu holds fast to the golden calves and Israel loses land
description: Although Jehu is promised that his descendants will sit on the throne of Israel for four generations because of his actions against the house of Ahab, he does not turn away from Jeroboam's sin with the golden calves in Bethel and Dan. Therefore, the Lord begins to cut off parts of Israel, and Hazael defeats the Israelites in the regions east of the Jordan. Jehu reigns 28 years in Samaria, and his son Jehoahaz becomes king after him.
